description: EE1: a transformed Ditto leaving and coming back. Setup turn 1: Ditto (Limber) transforms into Garchomp after its Swords Dance (Transform PP 12 -> 11, +2 Atk copied). Setup turn 2: it uses its copied Swords Dance (5 -> 4 PP). Setup turn 3: it switches out for Pelipper: clearVolatile restores the species, types, stored stats, ability and its own move slots (Transform at 11 PP), and the stages go. The turn: Ditto switches back in as a Ditto with its own moves; Garchomp's Swords Dance at +6 fails.
